Customer experience · Website in development

Imani Events

I help with wedding décor and marketing at Imani Events in Cardiff. I wanted couples to find a style they liked and ask for a quote while the details were still in front of them.

From the gallery to a quote

I helped plan the pages and coordinated the AI-assisted development. Visitors can browse stages, table settings and packages. The enquiry form asks for the date, venue, guest count and budget. These details give the team a starting point for checking availability and discussing what would fit the room.

Trying a design in the room

I proposed the visualiser to help couples see how a stage and a table setting would look together in the same room. I also specified which design details should carry through to a quote. In the development version, visitors can choose a venue and stage, adjust the décor and shortlist up to three designs.

From a saved design to an enquiry

Local checks covered comparing a design with the empty room, saving and shortlisting designs, and carrying a selection into the enquiry form. A study with couples could examine how they interpret the illustrated room and what they still need to see before asking for a quote.

My earlier MSc survey asked how people heard about Imani Events and what they valued in a décor supplier. It provides a starting point for that question.
